title: Wine Drunk Teacher Has Extreme Meltdown After DUI Arrest
description:
An Illinois elementary school teacher was arrested for allegedly driving drunk after leaving a basketball game. Police took Becki Miranda, 46, into custody after she was allegedly seen crossing over double yellow lines while driving, according to the Lake Forest Police Department. The 46-year-old can be seen on body camera video repeatedly telling the officers they were being “Inappropriate” and becoming increasingly emotional. At one point Miranda admits to having “one” glass of wine, but after a breathalyzer, that doesn’t exactly add up. Watch the incident unfold on this episode of Law&Crime BodyCam.
